top_signals.title: Tokyo Court Says Shidax Undervalued the Firm in Rare Case
top_signals.summary: The Tokyo District Court ruled that hospitality sector company Shidax Corp.’s tender offer in 2023 to go private undervalued its shares, in one of the still-rare cases in Japan of financial tussles between companies getting resolved by legal authorities.
